provenance: Original built-in image_gen sprites; reference game screenshots guide appearance only and are not extracted.
collision: none; rendered on existing mountain cells only
format: RGBA8, six opaque colours plus zeroed transparent pixels
normalization: Chroma key removal, 2 by 2 slicing, contained 60 by 42 content, fixed six-colour quantization without dithering; binary alpha
world_scale: 12 source pixels per terrain cell; broad crests occupy 128 by 96 source pixels at nearest 2x enlargement, narrow summits use the same 64 by 48 native frames
sampling: nearest, lossless import, no alpha-border recolouring, no source mipmaps; shared live overview downsample
placement: Stable jittered world anchors, selected by saved elevation and local relief; complete top/side/rock-foot shapes replace tiled white masks
dependencies: Each footprint depends on local height and supporting mountain cells. An 11-cell halo covers these dependencies for direct and worker redraws.
replacement: Rejected snow-rock source, raster and imports deleted. No alternate production versions or texture-fill fallback.
state: Integrated in Windows 0.23; 26 terrain checks, 26 native checks, pixel inspection and export startup verified. User aesthetic acceptance remains separate.
